description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the stocks skill located at /home/user/stocks with a virtual environment at /home/user/stocks/.venv/bin/python3 and scripts at /home/user/stocks/scripts/. 2. Agent must navigate to /home/user/stocks/scripts/ and use the venv Python interpreter (not system python3) to avoid ModuleNotFoundError. 3. Agent must use sys.path.insert(0, '.') to properly import yfinance_ai. 4. Agent calls compare_stocks(tickers='NVDA,AMD,INTC') using the proprietary comma-separated string format (not a list) to get comparative data. 5. Agent calls get_key_ratios(ticker='NVDA'), get_key_ratios(ticker='AMD'), get_key_ratios(ticker='INTC') individually to get ratio data per company. 6. Agent calls get_analyst_recommendations(ticker='NVDA'), get_analyst_recommendations(ticker='AMD'), get_analyst_recommendations(ticker='INTC') to get analyst sentiment. 7. All calls must be wrapped in asyncio.run() since all methods are async. 8. Agent aggregates all results into a single semiconductor_report.json file with all three tickers, comparative data, key ratios, and analyst data. 9. File must be substantive real data, not a placeholder.
